description: This file defines a generic Tree data structure with methods for mapping, filtering, pruning, and probabilistic picking, along with associated unit tests.

classes.name: Tree<T>
classes.description: A generic enum representing a tree with leaf and branch variants, supporting serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: try_map
methods.description: Transforms the tree by applying a function that can fail, returning a new tree or an error.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters the tree based on a predicate, removing nodes that do not satisfy the condition.

methods.name: prune_to_size
methods.description: Recursively prunes the tree to remove empty branches, returning the size of the tree.

methods.name: prune
methods.description: Prunes the tree and returns an Option, None if the tree is empty after pruning.

methods.name: pick
methods.description: Selects a random element from the tree based on branch weights, using a provided RNG.
